name: SpendZero: No Spend Challenge
subtitle: Money Saving Game & Streaks
promotionalText: New: seal every no-spend day with a gold coin, grow a wealth tree that's one of a kind, and celebrate bigger level-ups. No account, no ads. Now in 10 languages.
description:
Turn not spending into winning. SpendZero is a no-spend challenge that rewards every day you keep your money in your pocket — with streaks, XP, quests, badges, and a wealth tree that grows gold coins as you save.

Doing a no-spend month, a low-buy year, or just sick of your pay disappearing before the next payday? SpendZero makes every no-spend day feel like a win.

SEAL YOUR DAY
Mark a no-spend day and watch it get sealed with a gold coin. Your streak ticks up, your rewards pop in, and you can see exactly how close you are to your next milestone. One tap — and it feels great.

GROW YOUR WEALTH TREE
Your tree is one of a kind. It grows with every level, hangs gold coins as your savings add up, and thrives while your streak is alive. Let your streak lapse and it starts to wilt — log a no-spend day to bring it back.

A GAME YOU WIN BY NOT SPENDING
• Streaks, with streak freezes that cover you on a rough day
• Daily and weekly quests that progress from what you actually do
• 25 levels, from Frugal Novice to Wealth King
• Badges for 7-, 30-, 100- and 365-day streaks and savings milestones
• Challenges like the 7-Day No-Spend Sprint, Coffee Detox Week and the 30-Day No-Spend Challenge, plus Meal Prep, Subscription Audit, Impulse Control, Saving Sprint and Minimalist — or create your own

CRUSH IMPULSE BUYS
Tempted to splurge on something in your cart? Log it. Walk away and the money counts as saved, with XP to prove it. Gave in? No worries — log it and keep going. Essentials like groceries and transport don't break your no-spend day.

NEVER BREAK THE CHAIN
• Interactive Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: mark today without opening the app
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Log a no-spend day in SpendZero"
• A gentle evening check-in at your usual time, with one-tap buttons
• Forgot yesterday? A morning reminder lets you count it before your streak breaks

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
A streak calendar with day-by-day detail, savings charts, and a shareable story card every time you seal a day. Export a PDF report whenever you like.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything you log stays on your iPhone. No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking.

Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Dutch, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese and Chinese.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
SpendZero Pro is available weekly, monthly or yearly, or as a one-off lifetime purchase. Monthly and yearly plans may include a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Prices are shown in the app in your local currency. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel at any time in your App Store account settings.

whatsNew:
